scripts.dev: concurrently -n "backend,frontend" -c "blue,green" "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix frontend && npm install --prefix backend
scripts.build:deploy: npm install --include=dev --prefix frontend && npm install --prefix backend && npm run build --prefix frontend
scripts.start: npm run migrate --prefix backend && npm start --prefix backend
